releaseNotes: 🔔 Notifications Inbox: View all past agency announcements anytime from the new bell icon on your Dashboard.
📲 Direct Phone Notifications: Receive important announcements directly in your phone notification center.
🌐 Language Matching: Announcements now seamlessly adapt to your preferred language (English / Bahasa Melayu).
✨ Smarter Dashboard: Dismissed announcement banners stay closed permanently with zero startup flash.
